title: 2-Minute Morning Posture Routine
style: Dreamy pastel synthwave illustration, soft gradients, lavender background, gentle glow, clean minimal setting, consistent lighting, portrait 2:3 vertical composition.
character: Same 19–20-year-old adult character in every slide, fully clothed in a pastel fitted t-shirt and athletic shorts, sneakers, friendly face, natural proportions, neat hair, confident but relaxed energy.
voice: Upbeat, friendly, brisk, encouraging, simple and clear.

exercises.name: OVERHEAD REACH
exercises.a: Portrait 2:3 dreamy pastel synthwave illustration on a plain lavender gradient background; same young adult character centered with generous margins, whole body visible, top 18% of image completely empty for captions, no text, no letters, no numbers. Front-facing standing pose: both feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, toes pointing forward, knees softly straight, pelvis neutral, torso upright, shoulders relaxed, arms hanging naturally at both sides with palms facing thighs, head level, eyes forward.
exercises.b: Portrait 2:3 dreamy pastel synthwave illustration on a plain lavender gradient background; same young adult character centered with generous margins, whole body visible, top 18% of image completely empty for captions, no text, no letters, no numbers. Same camera angle and framing as pose a. Front-facing standing reach: both feet stay flat on the floor hip-width apart, toes forward, knees softly straight, pelvis neutral, torso tall, both arms extended straight overhead, elbows long, fingers reaching upward, palms facing each other, shoulders lifted gently but not hunched, chin level, spine lengthened without back arching.

exercises.name: WALL STAND
exercises.a: Portrait 2:3 dreamy pastel synthwave illustration on a clean lavender pastel wall-and-floor background with a subtle wall plane, no clutter; same young adult character centered with generous margins, whole body visible, top 18% of image completely empty for captions, no text, no letters, no numbers. Side view standing against the wall: heels 2 inches from the wall and both feet flat hip-width apart, knees soft, glutes and upper back touching the wall, head slightly forward away from the wall, arms relaxed down by sides, shoulders a little rounded, eyes forward.
exercises.b: Portrait 2:3 dreamy pastel synthwave illustration on the same clean lavender pastel wall-and-floor background with subtle wall plane, no clutter; same young adult character centered with generous margins, whole body visible, top 18% of image completely empty for captions, no text, no letters, no numbers. Same side camera angle and framing as pose a. Corrected wall stand: heels remain 2 inches from the wall and both feet flat hip-width apart, knees soft, glutes, upper back, and back of head gently touching the wall, chin tucked slightly, neck long, shoulders rolled back and down, arms relaxed straight by sides with palms facing thighs, ribs stacked over hips.

result: Portrait 2:3 dreamy pastel synthwave illustration on a plain lavender gradient background; same young adult character centered with generous margins, whole body visible, top 18% of image completely empty, no text, no letters, no numbers. The character stands tall and relaxed with great posture, feet flat hip-width apart, knees soft, ribs stacked over hips, shoulders open and down, neck long, chin level, arms relaxed at sides, proud happy smile, calm confident energy.

lines.hook: Do this every morning to wake up your posture.
lines.ex1: Overhead reaches decompress your sides and help you stand taller.
lines.ex2: Wall stands reset your shoulders, neck, and stacked alignment.
lines.takeaway: Two minutes daily, then open TallPlan for your plan.
